sentences.en: "Ziri offers companionship." "What do you mean?" "He provides escorts."
sentences.zh: 1. "Ziri 提供陪伴。" "你是什么意思？" "他是提供陪同服务的。"

sentences.en: Pets offer us more than mere companionship.
sentences.zh: 2. 宠物带给我们的不仅仅是陪伴。

sentences.en: All I want is some companionship.
sentences.zh: 3. 我想要的只是有人陪伴。
